page.layout: One title page: the title block centred at the top, a short imprint block below it, a printer's device (woodcut) in the centre, and the date line at the foot. Ghosted, mirrored text from the reverse of the leaf runs through the title and imprint; it is not transcribed.
page.notes: Title block and imprint are faint; the lines marked illegible could not be read reliably. The woodcut device in the centre carries no text. The spaced capitals in the title (M O D E R N A E) are read as MODERNAE with some doubt. The date line is set at the foot of the page and reads as printed in the scan. Mirrored show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
